headline: 半夜踢踏震出國安危機
ticker: 樓上狂踩疑啟動地殼｜樓下棉被宣布戒嚴｜拖鞋特使緊急上樓
anchor_script: 深夜驚爆！樓上鄰居不是失眠，竟在客廳密訓踢踏舞！一腳下去，樓下布丁集體暈船！兩腳連發，枕頭當場申請避難！住戶抱棉被成立自救會，派出拖鞋特使攻頂交涉！沒想到門一開，對方還邀請加練！這究竟是才藝復興，還是全棟被迫出道？目前雙方已鋪好軟墊，國家睡眠防線暫時守住！
cast: The downstairs resident is a 35-year-old woman with a short black bob, yellow pajamas, and blue slippers, and the upstairs tap dancer is a 50-year-old man with curly gray hair, purple pajamas, and black tap shoes.

shots.scene_en: In a midnight upstairs living room, the curly gray-haired man in purple pajamas and black tap shoes performs wildly exaggerated tap steps, filmed from a low angle beside his feet, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In the downstairs bedroom, the black-bobbed woman in yellow pajamas and blue slippers watches pudding wobble violently on her bedside table while clutching her quilt, filmed in a tilted close-up, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In the apartment stairwell, the black-bobbed woman in yellow pajamas and blue slippers marches upstairs wrapped in her quilt like a ceremonial cape, filmed from an overhead angle, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

At the upstairs apartment doorway, the curly gray-haired man in purple pajamas and black tap shoes enthusiastically demonstrates a dance step to the stunned black-bobbed woman in yellow pajamas and blue slippers wrapped in a quilt, filmed in a wide two-shot, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In the upstairs living room, the curly gray-haired man in purple pajamas and black tap shoes tiptoes on thick foam mats while the black-bobbed woman in yellow pajamas and blue slippers sleeps peacefully under her quilt on the sofa, filmed in a wide eye-level shot, with no text, letters, or logos visible.
